items.followUp: Convert (11010110)₂ to hexadecimal, showing how you group the binary digits.

rubric.why: Checks that the binary digits are grouped correctly for conversion.
rubric.description: Groups the binary digits into groups of four, starting from the right, padding the leftmost group with zeros if necessary.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for correctly stating or showing the grouping method.

rubric.why: Checks the hexadecimal conversion in the example.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the correct hexadecimal result.

modelAnswer: Starting from the right, group the binary digits into sets of four; add zeros to the left if needed: (1000001)₂ = (0100 0001)₂.
Convert each group to a hexadecimal digit: 0100 = 4 and 0001 = 1.
